purpose: Semantic-duration normalization for effects where a finite numeric timer is not the correct representation.

rules.permanent: Use explicit permanent-while-equipped wording when the effect is [Always].
rules.condition_bound: Use explicit condition-active wording when the effect is tied to a persistent state such as HP threshold, transformation, or max resource.
rules.instantaneous: Use explicit trigger-event wording for effects that occur as an immediate resource/stat event rather than a sustained buff.
rules.finite_timer_boundary: Do not convert trigger delays or undocumented durations into numeric timers.

changes.157: Permanent while equipped; conditional Ki Blast boost while Stamina is maxed
changes.170: While Kaioken or Super Saiyan Blue Kaioken is active
changes.201: While the corresponding charged-hit stack remains active; stack duration not numerically established
changes.229: While the charge-skill activation effect remains active; exact duration not established
changes.237: Permanent self guard-break modifier; all-attack stacks persist until otherwise cleared; exact timer not established
changes.239: Until the corresponding charged Ki Blast stack expires; exact timer not established

evidence_boundary: No numeric duration was invented. In particular, 159/174 remain activation-delay records and 201/237/239 retain unresolved finite stack-expiry timing.
